entries.mitigation: Watch the mirror for the glowing platform and move there before Annihilation finishes so your side teleports across instead of wiping.
entries.notes: Reviewed Lucent Citadel guide evidence places the paired Annihilation cycle at roughly 60 seconds and requires the correct glowing mirror platform to swap sides.

entries.mitigation: Balance boss health and kill them together. On Veteran and Hard Mode, finish the surviving boss within 10 seconds or the dead boss returns at 30% health.
entries.notes: Normal uses a 20-second rejuvenation window; Veteran and Hard Mode use 10 seconds.

entries.entry_name: Gloomy Impact — Count Ryelaz and Zilyesset
entries.mitigation: Ryelaz side should spread for the meteors after his heavy. Do not stack the impact circles on each other.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence ties Gloomy Impact meteors to Ryelaz's heavy attack and warns their damage can overlap.

entries.mitigation: Assign mirror players before pull. At 90%, 60%, 40%, and 15%, flip every required mirror before the channel finishes or Incandescent Destruction wipes the raid.
entries.notes: Mirror count grows from four to six to eight; Hard Mode retains the 15% Color Change.

entries.mitigation: Main tank positions Orphic so Shockwave hits the active Fate Pillar. Block or dodge the expanding wave after the slam.
entries.notes: Fate Pillars can only be destroyed by Orphic's Shockwave.

entries.mitigation: Do not let Fate Sealer finish. Bring Orphic to the pillar and use the boss's Shockwave to destroy it before the beams kill the group.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence identifies an unfinished Fate Sealer as lethal.

entries.mitigation: Farthest players should place the shard drops away from the stack and move out of the persistent crystal ground hazards.
entries.notes: Official U42 patch notes correct Volley to Magic damage; guide evidence says it prefers distant players and leaves dangerous crystal areas.

entries.entry_name: Xoryn Thunder Thrall — Orphic Shattered Shard
entries.mitigation: Off-tank keeps Xoryn away from the stack while the assigned healer controls the furthest-player jump location. Do not let Thunder Thrall land in the group.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence describes a common off-tank plus healer assignment for Xoryn during Orphic.

entries.mitigation: Tank swap after every Accelerating Charge. Weakening Charge lasts 20 seconds; taking the next charge while marked can be fatal.
entries.notes: Reviewed veteran/HM guide evidence requires alternating tanks after the channeled heavy.

entries.mitigation: Keep blocking until Chain Lightning has actually reached you. In Hard Mode an unblocked hit can kill you even if the earlier jumps already happened.
entries.notes: Official U42 notes say a cast no longer repeats the same target and does not arc to the Arcane Knot carrier.

entries.mitigation: Preassign a handoff order. In Hard Mode pass Current every 10–15 seconds and never return it to a player with the 90-second Overloaded Current debuff.
entries.notes: Official U42 notes increased damage when Current is held too long; reviewed guide evidence gives the 60-second HM duration and 90-second reuse lockout.

entries.mitigation: Move to assigned mirror positions before the beams fire and make only small adjustments. Hard Mode targets all 12 players, so overlapping beams turns one mistake into several.
entries.notes: Reviewed guide evidence places Hard Mode Tempest Assault at roughly a 30-second cadence.

entries.mitigation: Keep the Knot carrier close enough for healing, use a planned carrying order, and drop fracture away from the group without outranging support. Hard Mode gives less time to manage Knot and Fracture states.
entries.notes: Official U42 patch notes reduced Hard Mode Arcane Knot and Arcane Fracture durations and increased damage on already-fractured targets.
